summary.text: Jason Murillo is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for the open State Senate District 27 seat. A Lower East Side native known as "DJ Loud Mouth" in radio and media, he is listed by Ballotpedia as a politician and attorney. He ran for New York City Council District 2 in 2025 and lost the general election, and was listed as a withdrawn or disqualified candidate in the February 2026 special election for Assembly District 74.

paragraphs.text: Jason Murillo was born in New York City and graduated from Seward Park High School.

In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as a lifelong Lower East Side and East Village resident and, under the name "DJ Loudmouth," a media producer and radio host with about 20 years in television and radio, including programming on WPAT 930 AM; Ballotpedia lists his profession as politician and attorney.

In that survey he also describes himself as a Manhattan Republican Party member, chair of the Manhattan Young Conservatives Club, a community board member, and a 74th Assembly District leader and leader of the Manhattan Conservative Party, though the survey gives both current and former district leader titles.
Murillo was the Republican and Conservative candidate for New York City Council District 2 in November 2025, losing to Harvey Epstein (D/WFP), 78.0% to 16.5%.

Ballotpedia lists him as a withdrawn or disqualified Republican/Conservative candidate in the February 3, 2026 special election for New York Assembly District 74, won by Keith Powers (D); he did not appear on that ballot.
He advanced to the general election for Senate District 27 after the June 23, 2026 Republican and Conservative primaries were canceled.
